top.title: Missed off-plan payments in Dubai? Here's what your developer can legally do
top.teaser: Can a Dubai developer cancel your off-plan contract and keep your money the moment you miss a payment? The short answer is no, but the process matters. Buying off-plan has become one of the most popular routes to property ownership in Dubai, offering investors the chance to secure units during early project stages and spread payments across construction milestones. top.headline: Legal rules for missed Dubai off-plan payments
top.summary: Developers cannot instantly cancel contracts or seize funds when buyers miss payments. Specific legal procedures must be followed.
top.why: Protects investor capital by clarifying developer legal limitations during payment defaults.
